# Little Black Book (LBBOnline)

> LBBOnline is a searchable advertising creativity platform connecting the global creative industry with news, talent opportunities, and portfolio showcase.

LBBOnline serves as a comprehensive hub for the advertising and creative services industry, aggregating agency portfolios, job listings, industry news, and awards recognition. The platform features prominent creative organizations, production companies, and award-winning work from major campaigns and industry events.

## Key Topics

- Creative industry directory
- Advertising agencies
- Production companies
- Creative work portfolio
- Industry news
- Job listings
- Awards and recognition
- Member companies
- Little Black Book
- Immortal Awards
- CASEY
- Super Bowl campaigns
- Talent marketplace

## Core Platform

- [Little Black Book | LBBOnline](https://lbbonline.com): LBBOnline homepage: searchable advertising creativity platform with news, jobs, talent
